arguments.content:
"""MIPS32 interpreter integration for C033.

combine(payload, left, right) consumes the two component values:
  left  = [entry, [[address, byte], ...]]   (elf_segments)
  right = [files_map, stdin_bytes]          (io_buffers)
and produces the full business result JSON described in TASK.md.
"""

MASK32 = 0xFFFFFFFF


def _s32(v):
    v &= MASK32
    return v - (1 << 32) if v & (1 << 31) else v


def _u32(v):
    return v & MASK32


def _sign_extend(v, bits):
    v &= (1 << bits) - 1
    if v & (1 << (bits - 1)):
        v -= 1 << bits
    return v


class _Machine:
    def __init__(self, payload, left, right):
        entry, pairs = left
        self.entry = entry
        self.mem = {}
        for addr, byte in pairs:
            self.mem[addr & MASK32] = byte & 0xFF

        files_map, stdin_bytes = right
        self.files = {name: list(data) for name, data in files_map.items()}
        self.stdin = list(stdin_bytes)

        self.regs = [0] * 32
        self.hi = 0
        self.lo = 0
        sp = payload.get("stack_pointer")
        self.regs[29] = _u32(sp) if sp is not None else 0x7FFF0000

        self.inspect = payload.get("inspect") or []
        self.max_steps = payload.get("max_steps", 20000)

        self.stdout = bytearray()
        self.stderr = bytearray()
        self.syscalls = []
        self.steps = 0
        self.exit_code = None

        # File descriptors: 0 stdin, 1 stdout, 2 stderr.
        self.fds = {
            0: {"kind": "stdin", "pos": 0},
            1: {"kind": "stdout"},
            2: {"kind": "stderr"},
        }
        self.next_fd = 3

    # ---- memory helpers ----
    def read_byte(self, addr):
        return self.mem.get(addr & MASK32, 0)

    def read_half(self, addr):
        a = addr & MASK32
        return self.read_byte(a) | (self.read_byte(a + 1) << 8)

    def read_word(self, addr):
        a = addr & MASK32
        return (
            self.read_byte(a)
            | (self.read_byte(a + 1) << 8)
            | (self.read_byte(a + 2) << 16)
            | (self.read_byte(a + 3) << 24)
        )

    def write_byte(self, addr, val):
        self.mem[addr & MASK32] = val & 0xFF

    def write_half(self, addr, val):
        a = addr & MASK32
        self.write_byte(a, val & 0xFF)
        self.write_byte(a + 1, (val >> 8) & 0xFF)

    def write_word(self, addr, val):
        a = addr & MASK32
        self.write_byte(a, val & 0xFF)
        self.write_byte(a + 1, (val >> 8) & 0xFF)
        self.write_byte(a + 2, (val >> 16) & 0xFF)
        self.write_byte(a + 3, (val >> 24) & 0xFF)

    # ---- syscalls ----
    def syscall(self):
        number = self.regs[2]
        a0 = self.regs[4]
        a1 = self.regs[5]
        a2 = self.regs[6]
        self.syscalls.append({"number": number, "args": [a0, a1, a2]})
        result = 0
        if number == 4001:  # exit
            self.exit_code = a0 & 0xFF
            result = 0
        elif number == 4003:  # read(fd, buffer, n)
            fd = a0
            buf = a1
            n = a2
            data = self._read_fd(fd, n)
            for i, b in enumerate(data):
                self.write_byte(buf + i, b)
            result = len(data)
        elif number == 4004:  # write(fd, buffer, n)
            fd = a0
            buf = a1
            n = a2
            data = bytes(self.read_byte(buf + i) for i in range(n))
            self._write_fd(fd, data)
            result = n
        elif number == 4005:  # open(filename, flags, mode)
            filename = self._read_cstring(a0)
            flags = a1
            self._open(filename, flags)
            result = self.next_fd - 1
        elif number == 4006:  # close(fd)
            fd = a0
            if fd in self.fds and fd >= 3:
                del self.fds[fd]
            result = 0
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown syscall %d" % number)
        self.regs[2] = _u32(result)
        self.regs[7] = 0

    def _read_cstring(self, addr):
        out = bytearray()
        a = addr & MASK32
        while True:
            b = self.read_byte(a)
            if b == 0:
                break
            out.append(b)
            a = (a + 1) & MASK32
        return bytes(out).decode("utf-8")

    def _read_fd(self, fd, n):
        if fd == 0:
            pos = self.fds[0]["pos"]
            data = self.stdin[pos:pos + n]
            self.fds[0]["pos"] = pos + len(data)
            return data
        if fd in self.fds and self.fds[fd]["kind"] == "file":
            f = self.fds[fd]
            pos = f["pos"]
            data = f["data"][pos:pos + n]
            f["pos"] = pos + len(data)
            return data
        return []

    def _write_fd(self, fd, data):
        if fd == 1:
            self.stdout.extend(data)
        elif fd == 2:
            self.stderr.extend(data)
        elif fd in self.fds and self.fds[fd]["kind"] == "file":
            f = self.fds[fd]
            pos = f["pos"]
            f["data"][pos:pos + len(data)] = list(data)
            f["pos"] = pos + len(data)

    def _open(self, filename, flags):
        if flags == 0:  # read-only existing
            data = list(self.files.get(filename, []))
        elif flags == 1:  # create/truncate
            data = []
        elif flags == 9:  # append create
            data = list(self.files.get(filename, []))
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown open flags %d" % flags)
        fd = self.next_fd
        self.next_fd += 1
        self.fds[fd] = {"kind": "file", "name": filename, "data": data, "pos": 0}
        if flags == 9:
            self.fds[fd]["pos"] = len(data)

    # ---- execution ----
    def run(self):
        pc = self.entry & MASK32
        while self.exit_code is None:
            if self.steps >= self.max_steps:
                raise RuntimeError("max_steps exceeded")
            self.steps += 1
            instr = self.read_word(pc)
            pc = self.execute(instr, pc)
        return pc

    def execute(self, instr, pc):
        op = (instr >> 26) & 0x3F
        rs = (instr >> 21) & 0x1F
        rt = (instr >> 16) & 0x1F
        rd = (instr >> 11) & 0x1F
        shamt = (instr >> 6) & 0x1F
        funct = instr & 0x3F
        imm = instr & 0xFFFF
        target = instr & 0x3FFFFFF

        next_pc = (pc + 4) & MASK32

        if op == 0:
            return self.execute_rtype(funct, rs, rt, rd, shamt, pc, next_pc)
        elif op in (0x02, 0x03):  # j, jal
            return self.execute_j(op, target, pc, next_pc)
        elif op in (0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x07):  # beq, bne, blez, bgtz
            return self.execute_branch(op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc)
        elif op in (0x08, 0x09, 0x0A, 0x0B, 0x0C, 0x0D, 0x0E, 0x0F):
            return self.execute_imm(op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc)
        elif op in (0x20, 0x21, 0x22, 0x23, 0x24, 0x25, 0x28, 0x29, 0x2B):
            return self.execute_mem(op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc)
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown opcode 0x%02X at 0x%08X" % (op, pc))

    def execute_rtype(self, funct, rs, rt, rd, shamt, pc, next_pc):
        s = self.regs[rs]
        t = self.regs[rt]
        if funct == 0x00:  # sll
            self._set(rd, _u32(t << shamt))
        elif funct == 0x02:  # srl
            self._set(rd, _u32(t >> shamt))
        elif funct == 0x03:  # sra
            self._set(rd, _u32(_s32(t) >> shamt))
        elif funct == 0x08:  # jr
            return self.regs[rs] & MASK32
        elif funct == 0x09:  # jalr
            self._set(rd, next_pc)
            return self.regs[rs] & MASK32
        elif funct == 0x20:  # add
            self._set(rd, _u32(s + t))
        elif funct == 0x21:  # addu
            self._set(rd, _u32(s + t))
        elif funct == 0x22:  # sub
            self._set(rd, _u32(s - t))
        elif funct == 0x23:  # subu
            self._set(rd, _u32(s - t))
        elif funct == 0x24:  # and
            self._set(rd, s & t)
        elif funct == 0x25:  # or
            self._set(rd, s | t)
        elif funct == 0x26:  # xor
            self._set(rd, s ^ t)
        elif funct == 0x27:  # nor
            self._set(rd, _u32(~(s | t)))
        elif funct == 0x2A:  # slt
            self._set(rd, 1 if _s32(s) < _s32(t) else 0)
        elif funct == 0x2B:  # sltu
            self._set(rd, 1 if s < t else 0)
        elif funct == 0x10:  # mfhi
            self._set(rd, self.hi)
        elif funct == 0x12:  # mflo
            self._set(rd, self.lo)
        elif funct == 0x11:  # mthi
            self.hi = s
        elif funct == 0x13:  # mtlo
            self.lo = s
        elif funct == 0x18:  # mult
            prod = _s32(s) * _s32(t)
            self.lo = _u32(prod)
            self.hi = _u32(prod >> 32)
        elif funct == 0x19:  # multu
            prod = s * t
            self.lo = _u32(prod)
            self.hi = _u32(prod >> 32)
        elif funct == 0x1A:  # div
            a = _s32(s)
            b = _s32(t)
            q = int(a / b) if b != 0 else 0
            r = a - q * b
            self.lo = _u32(q)
            self.hi = _u32(r)
        elif funct == 0x1B:  # divu
            b = t
            q = s // b if b != 0 else 0
            r = s - q * b
            self.lo = _u32(q)
            self.hi = _u32(r)
        elif funct == 0x0C:  # syscall
            self.syscall()
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown funct 0x%02X at 0x%08X" % (funct, pc))
        return next_pc

    def execute_j(self, op, target, pc, next_pc):
        addr = ((pc + 4) & 0xF0000000) | (target << 2)
        if op == 0x03:  # jal
            self.regs[31] = next_pc
        return addr & MASK32

    def execute_branch(self, op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc):
        s = self.regs[rs]
        t = self.regs[rt]
        taken = False
        if op == 0x04:  # beq
            taken = s == t
        elif op == 0x05:  # bne
            taken = s != t
        elif op == 0x06:  # blez
            taken = _s32(s) <= 0
        elif op == 0x07:  # bgtz
            taken = _s32(s) > 0
        if taken:
            return _u32(pc + 4 + (_sign_extend(imm, 16) << 2))
        return next_pc

    def execute_imm(self, op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc):
        s = self.regs[rs]
        if op == 0x08:  # addi
            self._set(rt, _u32(s + _sign_extend(imm, 16)))
        elif op == 0x09:  # addiu
            self._set(rt, _u32(s + _sign_extend(imm, 16)))
        elif op == 0x0A:  # slti
            self._set(rt, 1 if _s32(s) < _sign_extend(imm, 16) else 0)
        elif op == 0x0B:  # sltiu
            self._set(rt, 1 if s < _u32(_sign_extend(imm, 16)) else 0)
        elif op == 0x0C:  # andi
            self._set(rt, s & imm)
        elif op == 0x0D:  # ori
            self._set(rt, s | imm)
        elif op == 0x0E:  # xori
            self._set(rt, s ^ imm)
        elif op == 0x0F:  # lui
            self._set(rt, _u32(imm << 16))
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown imm opcode 0x%02X" % op)
        return next_pc

    def execute_mem(self, op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc):
        addr = _u32(self.regs[rs] + _sign_extend(imm, 16))
        if op == 0x20:  # lb
            self._set(rt, _u32(_sign_extend(self.read_byte(addr), 8)))
        elif op == 0x24:  # lbu
            self._set(rt, self.read_byte(addr))
        elif op == 0x21:  # lh
            self._set(rt, _u32(_sign_extend(self.read_half(addr), 16)))
        elif op == 0x25:  # lhu
            self._set(rt, self.read_half(addr))
        elif op == 0x23:  # lw
            self._set(rt, self.read_word(addr))
        elif op == 0x28:  # sb
            self.write_byte(addr, self.regs[rt])
        elif op == 0x29:  # sh
            self.write_half(addr, self.regs[rt])
        elif op == 0x2B:  # sw
            self.write_word(addr, self.regs[rt])
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown mem opcode 0x%02X" % op)
        return next_pc

    def _set(self, reg, val):
        if reg != 0:
            self.regs[reg] = _u32(val)

    # ---- result ----
    def result(self):
        # Flush file contents back into the files map.
        files_out = {}
        for name, data in self.files.items():
            files_out[name] = bytes(data).hex()
        for fd, f in self.fds.items():
            if fd >= 3 and f["kind"] == "file":
                files_out[f["name"]] = bytes(f["data"]).hex()

        inspect_out = []
        for item in self.inspect:
            address = item["address"]
            length = item["length"]
            data = bytes(self.read_byte(address + i) for i in range(length))
            inspect_out.append({"address": address, "hex": data.hex()})

        return {
            "exit_code": self.exit_code,
            "registers": [self.regs[i] for i in range(32)],
            "hi": self.hi,
            "lo": self.lo,
            "steps": self.steps,
            "stdout_hex": bytes(self.stdout).hex(),
            "stderr_hex": bytes(self.stderr).hex(),
            "files": files_out,
            "inspect": inspect_out,
            "syscalls": self.syscalls,
        }


def combine(payload, left, right):
    """Combine the two component JSON values under the business contract in TASK.md."""
    machine = _Machine(payload, left, right)
    machine.run()
    return machine.result()

features.task:
# C033 ELF装载与MIPS32延迟槽/文件IO

实现一个可独立导入和命令行运行的组件。核心接口`transform(payload)`返回下述JSON结果，不修改输入对象。`load_payload(input_path)`读取UTF8 JSON并返回对象；`build_component(input_path,output_path)`独立读取、计算并将结果写入UTF8 JSON，返回相同结果。三个入口都须在无旧产物的全新目录工作。

## 公开业务契约

输入elf_hex为合法ELF32 little-endian ET_EXEC、EM_MIPS程序；按PT_LOAD的p_offset/p_vaddr/p_filesz/p_memsz装载，BSS补零。entry来自ELF头，内存为32位地址字节寻址。files映射UTF8文件名到初始字节hex；stdin_hex可省略；inspect为{address,length}列表。初始通用寄存器0，sp(29)默认0x7fff0000或stack_pointer，hi/lo为0。所有地址/无符号值为0..2^32-1，算术按32位回绕，r0始终为0。

import argparse
from hashlib import sha256
from importlib import import_module
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def write(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False), encoding="utf-8")


UNITS = read(ROOT / "components.json")


def project(payload, fields):
    return {k: payload[k] for k in fields if k in payload}


def fingerprint(value):
    text = json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
    return sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def sample_matches(actual, expected, tolerance):
    if isinstance(actual, bool) or isinstance(expected, bool):
        return type(actual) == type(expected) and actual == expected
    if isinstance(actual, (int, float)) and isinstance(expected, (int, float)):
        atol = tolerance.get("atol", 0) if isinstance(tolerance, dict) else tolerance
        rtol = tolerance.get("rtol", 0) if isinstance(tolerance, dict) else 0
        return math.isfinite(actual) and abs(actual - expected) <= atol + rtol * abs(expected)
    if isinstance(actual, dict) and isinstance(expected, dict):
        return actual.keys() == expected.keys() and all(sample_matches(actual[k], expected[k], tolerance) for k in actual)
    if isinstance(actual, list) and isinstance(expected, list):
        return len(actual) == len(expected) and all(sample_matches(x, y, tolerance) for x, y in zip(actual, expected))
    return type(actual) == type(expected) and actual == expected


def evaluate_unit(name, payload):
    return import_module("components." + name + ".work").compute(payload)


def persist(name, payload):
    folder = ROOT / "components" / name
    # Invalidate the slot before running so a failed retry cannot reuse an old result.
    write(folder / "result.json", None)
    value = evaluate_unit(name, payload)
    record = dict(component=name, input_sha256=fingerprint(payload), value=value)
    write(folder / "result.json", record)
    return record


def assemble(payload):
    from integration import combine
    values = []
    for name, fields in UNITS.items():
        record = read(ROOT / "components" / name / "result.json")
        if not isinstance(record, dict) or record.get("component") != name or record.get("input_sha256") != fingerprint(project(payload, fields)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} has no result for the given input")
        values.append(record["value"])
    return combine(payload, *values)


def transform(payload):
    from integration import combine
    values = [evaluate_unit(name, project(payload, fields)) for name, fields in UNITS.items()]
    return combine(payload, *values)


def build_component(input_path, output_path):
    payload = read(input_path)
    out = Path(output_path)
    if Path(input_path).resolve() == ROOT / "public_input.json" and out.resolve() == ROOT / "outputs/result.json":
        for name, fields in UNITS.items():
            persist(name, project(payload, fields))
        value = assemble(payload)
    else:
        value = transform(payload)
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    write(out, value)
    return value


def main():
    arg = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    arg.add_argument("action", choices=("run", "check", "join"))
    arg.add_argument("component", nargs="?", choices=tuple(UNITS))
    arg.add_argument("--input", type=Path, help="Full business input for run or join")
    arg.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=ROOT / "outputs/result.json")
    args = arg.parse_args()
    if args.action == "join":
        if args.component:arg.error("join accepts no component")
        write(args.output, assemble(read(args.input or ROOT / "public_input.json")))
        return
    if not args.component:arg.error("select a component")
    name = args.component
    folder = ROOT / "components" / name
    if args.action == "check":
        if args.input:arg.error("check uses the component's public fixture")
        value = evaluate_unit(name, read(folder / "input.json"))
        # Compare the JSON representation: tuples and JSON arrays have the same wire form.
        normalized = json.loads(json.dumps(value, allow_nan=False))
        if not sample_matches(normalized, read(folder / "expected.json"), read(ROOT / "work_units.json")["sample_tolerance"]):
            raise SystemExit(f"{name}: failed public example")
        print(f"{name}: passed public example")
    else:
        payload = project(read(args.input), UNITS[name]) if args.input else read(folder / "input.json")
        persist(name, payload)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

C033 ELF装载与MIPS32延迟槽/文件IO

实现一个可独立导入和命令行运行的组件。核心接口`transform(payload)`返回下述JSON结果，不修改输入对象。`load_payload(input_path)`读取UTF8 JSON并返回对象；`build_component(input_path,output_path)`独立读取、计算并将结果写入UTF8 JSON，返回相同结果。三个入口都须在无旧产物的全新目录工作。

## 公开业务契约

输入elf_hex为合法ELF32 little-endian ET_EXEC、EM_MIPS程序；按PT_LOAD的p_offset/p_vaddr/p_filesz/p_memsz装载，BSS补零。entry来自ELF头，内存为32位地址字节寻址。files映射UTF8文件名到初始字节hex；stdin_hex可省略；inspect为{address,length}列表。初始通用寄存器0，sp(29)默认0x7fff0000或stack_pointer，hi/lo为0。所有地址/无符号值为0..2^32-1，算术按32位回绕，r0始终为0。

公开指令子集：sll/srl/sra，jr/jalr，add/addu/sub/subu，and/or/xor/nor，slt/sltu，mfhi/mflo/mthi/mtlo，mult/multu/div/divu，syscall，j/jal，beq/bne/blez/bgtz，addi/addiu/slti/sltiu/andi/ori/xori/lui，lb/lbu/lh/lhu/lw/sb/sh/sw。有符号比较/算术右移用二补码；字节/半字加载按指令符号扩展；内存小端；立即数除andi/ori/xori/lui外符号扩展。合法输入无有符号溢出陷阱、除0、未对齐访问或延迟槽中的另一跳转。

所有跳转/分支有一个延迟槽；taken分支目标PC+4+(signext(imm)<<2)，j/jal使用PC+4高4位和26位目标；jal/jalr写回PC+8。div向0截断，hi为余数；mult hi/lo为64位乘积高低32位。

syscall编号在v0(2)，参数a0/a1/a2(4/5/6)，结果v0，成功a3(7)=0：4001 exit(a0低8位)；4003 read(fd,buffer,n)；4004 write(fd,buffer,n)；4005 open(filename,flags,mode)，flags=0只读已有文件、1创建/截断、9追加创建；4006 close(fd)。fd0为stdin，1/2为stdout/stderr，open从3起单调分配，文件偏移各fd独立；输入均为合法操作，无未知syscall。程序在max_steps(默认20000)内exit。

输出exit_code、registers(32个无符号值)、hi、lo、steps(含exit指令)、stdout_hex、stderr_hex、所有最终files、inspect每段address/hex、syscalls按调用顺序含number及调用前args=[a0,a1,a2]。这是公开子集解释器改编，不要求启动原DOOM或实现全部MIPS/FPU。

            taken = s == t
        elif op == 0x05:  # bne
            taken = s != t
        elif op == 0x06:  # blez
            taken = _s32(s) <= 0
        elif op == 0x07:  # bgtz
            taken = _s32(s) > 0

            "steps": self.steps,

            "stderr_hex": bytes(self.stderr).hex(),
            "files": files_out,
            "inspect": inspect_out,
            "syscalls": self.syscalls,
        }


def combine(payload, left, right):
    """Combine the two component JSON values under the business contract in TASK.md."""
    machine = _Machine(payload, left, right)
    machine.run()
    return machine.result()

            self.hi = _u32(r)

        elif op == 0x05:
            taken = s != t

        elif op == 0x25:
            self._set(rt, self.read_half(addr))
        elif op == 0x23:
            self._set(rt, self.read_word(addr))
        elif op == 0x28:
            self.write_byte(addr, self.regs[rt])
        elif op == 0x29:

        elif op == 0x2B:
            self.write_word(addr, self.regs[rt])

            "registers": [self.regs[i] for i in range(32)],

            "stderr_hex": bytes(self.stderr).hex(),
            "files": files_out,
            "inspect": inspect_out,
            "syscalls": self.syscalls,
        }

# C033 ELF装载与MIPS32延迟槽/文件IO

实现一个可独立导入和命令行运行的组件。核心接口`transform(payload)`返回下述JSON结果，不修改输入对象。`load_payload(input_path)`读取UTF8 JSON并返回对象；`build_component(input_path,output_path)`独立读取、计算并将结果写入UTF8 JSON，返回相同结果。三个入口都须在无旧产物的全新目录工作。

## 公开业务契约

输入elf_hex为合法ELF32 little-endian ET_EXEC、EM_MIPS程序；按PT_LOAD的p_offset/p_vaddr/p_filesz/p_memsz装载，BSS补零。entry来自ELF头，内存为32位地址字节寻址。files映射UTF8文件名到初始字节hex；stdin_hex可省略；inspect为{address,length}列表。初始通用寄存器0，sp(29)默认0x7fff0000或stack_pointer，hi/lo为0。所有地址/无符号值为0..2^32-1，算术按32位回绕，r0始终为0。

公开指令子集：sll/srl/sra，jr/jalr，add/addu/sub/subu，and/or/xor/nor，slt/sltu，mfhi/mflo/mthi/mtlo，mult/multu/div/divu，syscall，j/jal，beq/bne/blez/bgtz，addi/addiu/slti/sltiu/andi/ori/xori/lui，lb/lbu/lh/lhu/lw/sb/sh/sw。有符号比较/算术右移用二补码；字节/半字加载按指令符号扩展；内存小端；立即数除andi/ori/xori/lui外符号扩展。合法输入无有符号溢出陷阱、除0、未对齐访问或延迟槽中的另一跳转。

所有跳转/分支有一个延迟槽；taken分支目标PC+4+(signext(imm)<<2)，j/jal使用PC+4高4位和26位目标；jal/jalr写回PC+8。div向0截断，hi为余数；mult hi/lo为64位乘积高低32位。

syscall编号在v0(2)，参数a0/a1/a2(4/5/6)，结果v0，成功a3(7)=0：4001 exit(a0低8位)；4003 read(fd,buffer,n)；4004 write(fd,buffer,n)；4005 open(filename,flags,mode)，flags=0只读已有文件、1创建/截断、9追加创建；4006 close(fd)。fd0为stdin，1/2为stdout/stderr，open从3起单调分配，文件偏移各fd独立；输入均为合法操作，无未知syscall。程序在max_steps(默认20000)内exit。

输出exit_code、registers(32个无符号值)、hi、lo、steps(含exit指令)、stdout_hex、stderr_hex、所有最终files、inspect每段address/hex、syscalls按调用顺序含number及调用前args=[a0,a1,a2]。这是公开子集解释器改编，不要求启动原DOOM或实现全部MIPS/FPU。

## 交付与公开检查

在`solution.py`实现三个入口；可自行新增业务文件。`python run_all.py --check`运行小型公开例。`python run_all.py --input public_input.json --output output.json`生成产物。运行不依赖作者目录、既有output、网络或隐藏服务；不得修改run_all.py、public_input.json和public_expected.json。验收覆盖本文正常输入域与完整交付，不要求额外NaN/Infinity防御、错误文本、代码风格或未公开兼容范围。

## 可独立运行的业务文件

本版已接好 `solution.py` 的三个公开入口。实现下列两个组件的 `compute(payload)` 和工作区根目录 `integration.py` 的 `combine(payload, left, right)`。left、right 按表中两行的顺序对应，两项工作可同时开展。整合端消费组件的业务值，并完成题面其余计算。

| 实现文件 | 返回值约定 | 独占的结果文件 |
|---|---|---|
| `components/elf_segments/work.py` | 输出 [入口地址, [[地址,字节],…]]，按加载后的地址升序排列，包括 PT_LOAD 零填充。 | `components/elf_segments/result.json` |
| `components/io_buffers/work.py` | 返回 [文件名字节数组映射,标准输入字节数组]，未指定文件或 stdin 时为空。 | `components/io_buffers/result.json` |

from solution import transform
from math import isfinite
p=json.loads(Path('public_input.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

contract=json.loads(Path('contract.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
tol=contract.get('numeric_tolerance',0) or 0
def equal(a,b):
 if isinstance(a,bool) or isinstance(b,bool):return type(a)==type(b) and a==b
 if isinstance(a,(int,float)) and isinstance(b,(int,float)):
  atol=tol.get('atol',0) if isinstance(tol,dict) else tol
  rtol=tol.get('rtol',0) if isinstance(tol,dict) else 0
  return isfinite(a) and isfinite(b) and abs(a-b)<=atol+rtol*abs(b)
 if isinstance(a,dict) and isinstance(b,dict):return a.keys()==b.keys() and all(equal(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)
 if isinstance(a,list) and isinstance(b,list):return len(a)==len(b) and all(equal(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
 return type(a)==type(b) and a==b
assert equal(transform(p),expected)

# C033 ELF装载与MIPS32延迟槽/文件IO

实现一个可独立导入和命令行运行的组件。核心接口`transform(payload)`返回下述JSON结果，不修改输入对象。`load_payload(input_path)`读取UTF8 JSON并返回对象；`build_component(input_path,output_path)`独立读取、计算并将结果写入UTF8 JSON，返回相同结果。三个入口都须在无旧产物的全新目录工作。

## 公开业务契约

输入elf_hex为合法ELF32 little-endian ET_EXEC、EM_MIPS程序；按PT_LOAD的p_offset/p_vaddr/p_filesz/p_memsz装载，BSS补零。entry来自ELF头，内存为32位地址字节寻址。files映射UTF8文件名到初始字节hex；stdin_hex可省略；inspect为{address,length}列表。初始通用寄存器0，sp(29)默认0x7fff0000或stack_pointer，hi/lo为0。所有地址/无符号值为0..2^32-1，算术按32位回绕，r0始终为0。

公开指令子集：sll/srl/sra，jr/jalr，add/addu/sub/subu，and/or/xor/nor，slt/sltu，mfhi/mflo/mthi/mtlo，mult/multu/div/divu，syscall，j/jal，beq/bne/blez/bgtz，addi/addiu/slti/sltiu/andi/ori/xori/lui，lb/lbu/lh/lhu/lw/sb/sh/sw。有符号比较/算术右移用二补码；字节/半字加载按指令符号扩展；内存小端；立即数除andi/ori/xori/lui外符号扩展。合法输入无有符号溢出陷阱、除0、未对齐访问或延迟槽中的另一跳转。

所有跳转/分支有一个延迟槽；taken分支目标PC+4+(signext(imm)<<2)，j/jal使用PC+4高4位和26位目标；jal/jalr写回PC+8。div向0截断，hi为余数；mult hi/lo为64位乘积高低32位。

syscall编号在v0(2)，参数a0/a1/a2(4/5/6)，结果v0，成功a3(7)=0：4001 exit(a0低8位)；4003 read(fd,buffer,n)；4004 write(fd,buffer,n)；4005 open(filename,flags,mode)，flags=0只读已有文件、1创建/截断、9追加创建；4006 close(fd)。fd0为stdin，1/2为stdout/stderr，open从3起单调分配，文件偏移各fd独立；输入均为合法操作，无未知syscall。程序在max_steps(默认20000)内exit。

输出exit_code、registers(32个无符号值)、hi、lo、steps(含exit指令)、stdout_hex、stderr_hex、所有最终files、inspect每段address/hex、syscalls按调用顺序含number及调用前args=[a0,a1,a2]。这是公开子集解释器改编，不要求启动原DOOM或实现全部MIPS/FPU。

## 交付与公开检查

在`solution.py`实现三个入口；可自行新增业务文件。`python run_all.py --check`运行小型公开例。`python run_all.py --input public_input.json --output output.json`生成产物。运行不依赖作者目录、既有output、网络或隐藏服务；不得修改run_all.py、public_input.json和public_expected.json。验收覆盖本文正常输入域与完整交付，不要求额外NaN/Infinity防御、错误文本、代码风格或未公开兼容范围。

## 可独立运行的业务文件

本版已接好 `solution.py` 的三个公开入口。实现下列两个组件的 `compute(payload)` 和工作区根目录 `integration.py` 的 `combine(payload, left, right)`。left、right 按表中两行的顺序对应，两项工作可同时开展。整合端消费组件的业务值，并完成题面其余计算。

| 实现文件 | 返回值约定 | 独占的结果文件 |
|---|---|---|
| `components/elf_segments/work.py` | 输出 [入口地址, [[地址,字节],…]]，按加载后的地址升序排列，包括 PT_LOAD 零填充。 | `components/elf_segments/result.json` |
| `components/io_buffers/work.py` | 返回 [文件名字节数组映射,标准输入字节数组]，未指定文件或 stdin 时为空。 | `components/io_buffers/result.json` |

每个组件目录已有独立公开输入 `input.json`、样例结果 `expected.json` 及可覆写的 `result.json`。分别运行组件可落盘，汇总命令只读取两份已有结果。最终交付路径 `outputs/result.json` 也已预建。

```sh
python -B component_runtime.py check elf_segments
python -B component_runtime.py run elf_segments
python -B component_runtime.py check io_buffers
python -B component_runtime.py run io_buffers
python -B component_runtime.py join
python -B run_all.py --input public_input.json --output outputs/result.json
python -B public_check.py
```

默认组件样例与整题公开输入对应。处理另一个输入文件时，请在两个 run 命令和 join 命令上使用相同的 `--input PATH`。每次独立实验使用自己的题目工作区。组件样例仅供开发自检，正式评分继续使用整题的冻结用例。

"""MIPS32 interpreter integration for C033.

combine(payload, left, right) consumes the two component values:
  left  = [entry, [[address, byte], ...]]   (elf_segments)
  right = [files_map, stdin_bytes]          (io_buffers)
and produces the full business result JSON described in TASK.md.
"""

MASK32 = 0xFFFFFFFF


def _s32(v):
    v &= MASK32
    return v - (1 << 32) if v & (1 << 31) else v


def _u32(v):
    return v & MASK32


def _sign_extend(v, bits):
    v &= (1 << bits) - 1
    if v & (1 << (bits - 1)):
        v -= 1 << bits
    return v


class _Machine:
    def __init__(self, payload, left, right):
        entry, pairs = left
        self.entry = entry
        self.mem = {}
        for addr, byte in pairs:
            self.mem[addr & MASK32] = byte & 0xFF

        files_map, stdin_bytes = right
        self.files = {name: list(data) for name, data in files_map.items()}
        self.stdin = list(stdin_bytes)

        self.regs = [0] * 32
        self.hi = 0
        self.lo = 0
        sp = payload.get("stack_pointer")
        self.regs[29] = _u32(sp) if sp is not None else 0x7FFF0000

        self.inspect = payload.get("inspect") or []
        self.max_steps = payload.get("max_steps", 20000)

        self.stdout = bytearray()
        self.stderr = bytearray()
        self.syscalls = []
        self.steps = 0
        self.exit_code = None

        # File descriptors: 0 stdin, 1 stdout, 2 stderr.
        self.fds = {
            0: {"kind": "stdin", "pos": 0},
            1: {"kind": "stdout"},
            2: {"kind": "stderr"},
        }
        self.next_fd = 3

    # ---- memory helpers ----
    def read_byte(self, addr):
        return self.mem.get(addr & MASK32, 0)

    def read_half(self, addr):
        a = addr & MASK32
        return self.read_byte(a) | (self.read_byte(a + 1) << 8)

    def read_word(self, addr):
        a = addr & MASK32
        return (
            self.read_byte(a)
            | (self.read_byte(a + 1) << 8)
            | (self.read_byte(a + 2) << 16)
            | (self.read_byte(a + 3) << 24)
        )

    def write_byte(self, addr, val):
        self.mem[addr & MASK32] = val & 0xFF

    def write_half(self, addr, val):
        a = addr & MASK32
        self.write_byte(a, val & 0xFF)
        self.write_byte(a + 1, (val >> 8) & 0xFF)

    def write_word(self, addr, val):
        a = addr & MASK32
        self.write_byte(a, val & 0xFF)
        self.write_byte(a + 1, (val >> 8) & 0xFF)
        self.write_byte(a + 2, (val >> 16) & 0xFF)
        self.write_byte(a + 3, (val >> 24) & 0xFF)

    # ---- syscalls ----
    def syscall(self):
        number = self.regs[2]
        a0 = self.regs[4]
        a1 = self.regs[5]
        a2 = self.regs[6]
        self.syscalls.append({"number": number, "args": [a0, a1, a2]})
        result = 0
        if number == 4001:  # exit
            self.exit_code = a0 & 0xFF
            result = 0
        elif number == 4003:  # read(fd, buffer, n)
            fd = a0
            buf = a1
            n = a2
            data = self._read_fd(fd, n)
            for i, b in enumerate(data):
                self.write_byte(buf + i, b)
            result = len(data)
        elif number == 4004:  # write(fd, buffer, n)
            fd = a0
            buf = a1
            n = a2
            data = bytes(self.read_byte(buf + i) for i in range(n))
            self._write_fd(fd, data)
            result = n
        elif number == 4005:  # open(filename, flags, mode)
            filename = self._read_cstring(a0)
            flags = a1
            self._open(filename, flags)
            result = self.next_fd - 1
        elif number == 4006:  # close(fd)
            fd = a0
            if fd in self.fds and fd >= 3:
                del self.fds[fd]
            result = 0
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown syscall %d" % number)
        self.regs[2] = _u32(result)
        self.regs[7] = 0

    def _read_cstring(self, addr):
        out = bytearray()
        a = addr & MASK32
        while True:
            b = self.read_byte(a)
            if b == 0:
                break
            out.append(b)
            a = (a + 1) & MASK32
        return bytes(out).decode("utf-8")

    def _read_fd(self, fd, n):
        if fd == 0:
            pos = self.fds[0]["pos"]
            data = self.stdin[pos:pos + n]
            self.fds[0]["pos"] = pos + len(data)
            return data
        if fd in self.fds and self.fds[fd]["kind"] == "file":
            f = self.fds[fd]
            pos = f["pos"]
            data = f["data"][pos:pos + n]
            f["pos"] = pos + len(data)
            return data
        return []

    def _write_fd(self, fd, data):
        if fd == 1:
            self.stdout.extend(data)
        elif fd == 2:
            self.stderr.extend(data)
        elif fd in self.fds and self.fds[fd]["kind"] == "file":
            f = self.fds[fd]
            pos = f["pos"]
            f["data"][pos:pos + len(data)] = list(data)
            f["pos"] = pos + len(data)

    def _open(self, filename, flags):
        if flags == 0:  # read-only existing
            data = list(self.files.get(filename, []))
        elif flags == 1:  # create/truncate
            data = []
        elif flags == 9:  # append create
            data = list(self.files.get(filename, []))
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown open flags %d" % flags)
        fd = self.next_fd
        self.next_fd += 1
        self.fds[fd] = {"kind": "file", "name": filename, "data": data, "pos": 0}
        if flags == 9:
            self.fds[fd]["pos"] = len(data)

    # ---- execution ----
    def run(self):
        pc = self.entry & MASK32
        while self.exit_code is None:
            if self.steps >= self.max_steps:
                raise RuntimeError("max_steps exceeded")
            self.steps += 1
            instr = self.read_word(pc)
            pc = self.execute(instr, pc)
        return pc

    def execute(self, instr, pc):
        op = (instr >> 26) & 0x3F
        rs = (instr >> 21) & 0x1F
        rt = (instr >> 16) & 0x1F
        rd = (instr >> 11) & 0x1F
        shamt = (instr >> 6) & 0x1F
        funct = instr & 0x3F
        imm = instr & 0xFFFF
        target = instr & 0x3FFFFFF

        next_pc = (pc + 4) & MASK32

        if op == 0:
            return self.execute_rtype(funct, rs, rt, rd, shamt, pc, next_pc)
        elif op in (0x02, 0x03):  # j, jal
            return self.execute_j(op, target, pc, next_pc)
        elif op in (0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x07):  # beq, bne, blez, bgtz
            return self.execute_branch(op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc)
        elif op in (0x08, 0x09, 0x0A, 0x0B, 0x0C, 0x0D, 0x0E, 0x0F):
            return self.execute_imm(op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc)
        elif op in (0x20, 0x21, 0x22, 0x23, 0x24, 0x25, 0x28, 0x29, 0x2B):
            return self.execute_mem(op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc)
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown opcode 0x%02X at 0x%08X" % (op, pc))

    def execute_rtype(self, funct, rs, rt, rd, shamt, pc, next_pc):
        s = self.regs[rs]
        t = self.regs[rt]
        if funct == 0x00:  # sll
            self._set(rd, _u32(t << shamt))
        elif funct == 0x02:  # srl
            self._set(rd, _u32(t >> shamt))
        elif funct == 0x03:  # sra
            self._set(rd, _u32(_s32(t) >> shamt))
        elif funct == 0x08:  # jr
            return self.regs[rs] & MASK32
        elif funct == 0x09:  # jalr
            self._set(rd, next_pc)
            return self.regs[rs] & MASK32
        elif funct == 0x20:  # add
            self._set(rd, _u32(s + t))
        elif funct == 0x21:  # addu
            self._set(rd, _u32(s + t))
        elif funct == 0x22:  # sub
            self._set(rd, _u32(s - t))
        elif funct == 0x23:  # subu
            self._set(rd, _u32(s - t))
        elif funct == 0x24:  # and
            self._set(rd, s & t)
        elif funct == 0x25:  # or
            self._set(rd, s | t)
        elif funct == 0x26:  # xor
            self._set(rd, s ^ t)
        elif funct == 0x27:  # nor
            self._set(rd, _u32(~(s | t)))
        elif funct == 0x2A:  # slt
            self._set(rd, 1 if _s32(s) < _s32(t) else 0)
        elif funct == 0x2B:  # sltu
            self._set(rd, 1 if s < t else 0)
        elif funct == 0x10:  # mfhi
            self._set(rd, self.hi)
        elif funct == 0x12:  # mflo
            self._set(rd, self.lo)
        elif funct == 0x11:  # mthi
            self.hi = s
        elif funct == 0x13:  # mtlo
            self.lo = s
        elif funct == 0x18:  # mult
            prod = _s32(s) * _s32(t)
            self.lo = _u32(prod)
            self.hi = _u32(prod >> 32)
        elif funct == 0x19:  # multu
            prod = s * t
            self.lo = _u32(prod)
            self.hi = _u32(prod >> 32)
        elif funct == 0x1A:  # div
            a = _s32(s)
            b = _s32(t)
            q = int(a / b) if b != 0 else 0
            r = a - q * b
            self.lo = _u32(q)
            self.hi = _u32(r)
        elif funct == 0x1B:  # divu
            b = t
            q = s // b if b != 0 else 0
            r = s - q * b
            self.lo = _u32(q)
            self.hi = _u32(r)
        elif funct == 0x0C:  # syscall
            self.syscall()
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown funct 0x%02X at 0x%08X" % (funct, pc))
        return next_pc

    def execute_j(self, op, target, pc, next_pc):
        addr = ((pc + 4) & 0xF0000000) | (target << 2)
        if op == 0x03:  # jal
            self.regs[31] = next_pc
        return addr & MASK32

    def execute_branch(self, op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc):
        s = self.regs[rs]
        t = self.regs[rt]
        taken = False
        if op == 0x04:  # beq
            taken = s == t
        elif op == 0x05:  # bne
            taken = s != t
        elif op == 0x06:  # blez
            taken = _s32(s) <= 0
        elif op == 0x07:  # bgtz
            taken = _s32(s) > 0
        if taken:
            return _u32(pc + 4 + (_sign_extend(imm, 16) << 2))
        return next_pc

    def execute_imm(self, op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc):
        s = self.regs[rs]
        if op == 0x08:  # addi
            self._set(rt, _u32(s + _sign_extend(imm, 16)))
        elif op == 0x09:  # addiu
            self._set(rt, _u32(s + _sign_extend(imm, 16)))
        elif op == 0x0A:  # slti
            self._set(rt, 1 if _s32(s) < _sign_extend(imm, 16) else 0)
        elif op == 0x0B:  # sltiu
            self._set(rt, 1 if s < _u32(_sign_extend(imm, 16)) else 0)
        elif op == 0x0C:  # andi
            self._set(rt, s & imm)
        elif op == 0x0D:  # ori
            self._set(rt, s | imm)
        elif op == 0x0E:  # xori
            self._set(rt, s ^ imm)
        elif op == 0x0F:  # lui
            self._set(rt, _u32(imm << 16))
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown imm opcode 0x%02X" % op)
        return next_pc

    def execute_mem(self, op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc):
        addr = _u32(self.regs[rs] + _sign_extend(imm, 16))
        if op == 0x20:  # lb
            self._set(rt, _u32(_sign_extend(self.read_byte(addr), 8)))
        elif op == 0x24:  # lbu
            self._set(rt, self.read_byte(addr))
        elif op == 0x21:  # lh
            self._set(rt, _u32(_sign_extend(self.read_half(addr), 16)))
        elif op == 0x25:  # lhu
            self._set(rt, self.read_half(addr))
        elif op == 0x23:  # lw
            self._set(rt, self.read_word(addr))
        elif op == 0x28:  # sb
            self.write_byte(addr, self.regs[rt])
        elif op == 0x29:  # sh
            self.write_half(addr, self.regs[rt])
        elif op == 0x2B:  # sw
            self.write_word(addr, self.regs[rt])
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown mem opcode 0x%02X" % op)
        return next_pc

    def _set(self, reg, val):
        if reg != 0:
            self.regs[reg] = _u32(val)

    # ---- result ----
    def result(self):
        # Flush file contents back into the files map.
        files_out = {}
        for name, data in self.files.items():

        for fd, f in self.fds.items():

            "syscalls": self.syscalls,

# C033 ELF装载与MIPS32延迟槽/文件IO

实现一个可独立导入和命令行运行的组件。核心接口`transform(payload)`返回下述JSON结果，不修改输入对象。`load_payload(input_path)`读取UTF8 JSON并返回对象；`build_component(input_path,output_path)`独立读取、计算并将结果写入UTF8 JSON，返回相同结果。三个入口都须在无旧产物的全新目录工作。

## 公开业务契约

输入elf_hex为合法ELF32 little-endian ET_EXEC、EM_MIPS程序；按PT_LOAD的p_offset/p_vaddr/p_filesz/p_memsz装载，BSS补零。entry来自ELF头，内存为32位地址字节寻址。files映射UTF8文件名到初始字节hex；stdin_hex可省略；inspect为{address,length}列表。初始通用寄存器0，sp(29)默认0x7fff0000或stack_pointer，hi/lo为0。所有地址/无符号值为0..2^32-1，算术按32位回绕，r0始终为0。

公开指令子集：sll/srl/sra，jr/jalr，add/addu/sub/subu，and/or/xor/nor，slt/sltu，mfhi/mflo/mthi/mtlo，mult/multu/div/divu，syscall，j/jal，beq/bne/blez/bgtz，addi/addiu/slti/sltiu/andi/ori/xori/lui，lb/lbu/lh/lhu/lw/sb/sh/sw。有符号比较/算术右移用二补码；字节/半字加载按指令符号扩展；内存小端；立即数除andi/ori/xori/lui外符号扩展。合法输入无有符号溢出陷阱、除0、未对齐访问或延迟槽中的另一跳转。

所有跳转/分支有一个延迟槽；taken分支目标PC+4+(signext(imm)<<2)，j/jal使用PC+4高4位和26位目标；jal/jalr写回PC+8。div向0截断，hi为余数；mult hi/lo为64位乘积高低32位。

syscall编号在v0(2)，参数a0/a1/a2(4/5/6)，结果v0，成功a3(7)=0：4001 exit(a0低8位)；4003 read(fd,buffer,n)；4004 write(fd,buffer,n)；4005 open(filename,flags,mode)，flags=0只读已有文件、1创建/截断、9追加创建；4006 close(fd)。fd0为stdin，1/2为stdout/stderr，open从3起单调分配，文件偏移各fd独立；输入均为合法操作，无未知syscall。程序在max_steps(默认20000)内exit。

输出exit_code、registers(32个无符号值)、hi、lo、steps(含exit指令)、stdout_hex、stderr_hex、所有最终files、inspect每段address/hex、syscalls按调用顺序含number及调用前args=[a0,a1,a2]。这是公开子集解释器改编，不要求启动原DOOM或实现全部MIPS/FPU。

输入elf_hex为合法ELF32 little-endian ET_EXEC、EM_MIPS程序；按PT_LOAD的p_offset/p_vaddr/p_filesz/p_memsz装载，BSS补零。entry来自ELF头，内存为32位地址字节寻址。files映射UTF8文件名到初始字节hex；stdin_hex可省略；inspect为{address,length}列表。初始通用寄存器0，sp(29)默认0x7fff0000或stack_pointer，hi/lo为0。所有地址/无符号值为0..2^32-1，算术按32位回绕，r0始终为0。

公开指令子集：sll/srl/sra，jr/jalr，add/addu/sub/subu，and/or/xor/nor，slt/sltu，mfhi/mflo/mthi/mtlo，mult/multu/div/divu，syscall，j/jal，beq/bne/blez/bgtz，addi/addiu/slti/sltiu/andi/ori/xori/lui，lb/lbu/lh/lhu/lw/sb/sh/sw。有符号比较/算术右移用二补码；字节/半字加载按指令符号扩展；内存小端；立即数除andi/ori/xori/lui外符号扩展。合法输入无有符号溢出陷阱、除0、未对齐访问或延迟槽中的另一跳转。

所有跳转/分支有一个延迟槽；taken分支目标PC+4+(signext(imm)<<2)，j/jal使用PC+4高4位和26位目标；jal/jalr写回PC+8。div向0截断，hi为余数；mult hi/lo为64位乘积高低32位。

syscall编号在v0(2)，参数a0/a1/a2(4/5/6)，结果v0，成功a3(7)=0：4001 exit(a0低8位)；4003 read(fd,buffer,n)；4004 write(fd,buffer,n)；4005 open(filename,flags,mode)，flags=0只读已有文件、1创建/截断、9追加创建；4006 close(fd)。fd0为stdin，1/2为stdout/stderr，open从3起单调分配，文件偏移各fd独立；输入均为合法操作，无未知syscall。程序在max_steps(默认20000)内exit。

输出exit_code、registers(32个无符号值)、hi、lo、steps(含exit指令)、stdout_hex、stderr_hex、所有最终files、inspect每段address/hex、syscalls按调用顺序含number及调用前args=[a0,a1,a2]。这是公开子集解释器改编，不要求启动原DOOM或实现全部MIPS/FPU。

## 交付与公开检查

在`solution.py`实现三个入口；可自行新增业务文件。`python run_all.py --check`运行小型公开例。`python run_all.py --input public_input.json --output output.json`生成产物。运行不依赖作者目录、既有output、网络或隐藏服务；不得修改run_all.py、public_input.json和public_expected.json。验收覆盖本文正常输入域与完整交付，不要求额外NaN/Infinity防御、错误文本、代码风格或未公开兼容范围。

## 可独立运行的业务文件

| `components/elf_segments/work.py` | 输出 [入口地址, [[地址,字节],…]]，按加载后的地址升序排列，包括 PT_LOAD 零填充。 | `components/elf_segments/result.json` |

每个组件目录已有独立公开输入 `input.json`、样例结果 `expected.json` 及可覆写的 `result.json`。分别运行组件可落盘，汇总命令只读取两份已有结果。最终交付路径 `outputs/result.json` 也已预建。

arguments.content:
"""MIPS32 interpreter integration for C033.

combine(payload, left, right) consumes the two component values:
  left  = [entry, [[address, byte], ...]]   (elf_segments)
  right = [files_map, stdin_bytes]          (io_buffers)
and produces the full business result JSON described in TASK.md.
"""

MASK32 = 0xFFFFFFFF


def _s32(v):
    v &= MASK32
    return v - (1 << 32) if v & (1 << 31) else v


def _u32(v):
    return v & MASK32


def _sign_extend(v, bits):
    v &= (1 << bits) - 1
    if v & (1 << (bits - 1)):
        v -= 1 << bits
    return v


class _Machine:
    def __init__(self, payload, left, right):
        entry, pairs = left
        self.entry = entry
        self.mem = {}
        for addr, byte in pairs:
            self.mem[addr & MASK32] = byte & 0xFF

        files_map, stdin_bytes = right
        self.files = {name: list(data) for name, data in files_map.items()}
        self.stdin = list(stdin_bytes)

        self.regs = [0] * 32
        self.hi = 0
        self.lo = 0
        sp = payload.get("stack_pointer")
        self.regs[29] = _u32(sp) if sp is not None else 0x7FFF0000

        self.inspect = payload.get("inspect") or []
        self.max_steps = payload.get("max_steps", 20000)

        self.stdout = bytearray()
        self.stderr = bytearray()
        self.syscalls = []
        self.steps = 0
        self.exit_code = None

        # File descriptors: 0 stdin, 1 stdout, 2 stderr.
        self.fds = {
            0: {"kind": "stdin", "pos": 0},
            1: {"kind": "stdout"},
            2: {"kind": "stderr"},
        }
        self.next_fd = 3

    # ---- memory helpers ----
    def read_byte(self, addr):
        return self.mem.get(addr & MASK32, 0)

    def read_half(self, addr):
        a = addr & MASK32
        return self.read_byte(a) | (self.read_byte(a + 1) << 8)

    def read_word(self, addr):
        a = addr & MASK32
        return (
            self.read_byte(a)
            | (self.read_byte(a + 1) << 8)
            | (self.read_byte(a + 2) << 16)
            | (self.read_byte(a + 3) << 24)
        )

    def write_byte(self, addr, val):
        self.mem[addr & MASK32] = val & 0xFF

    def write_half(self, addr, val):
        a = addr & MASK32
        self.write_byte(a, val & 0xFF)
        self.write_byte(a + 1, (val >> 8) & 0xFF)

    def write_word(self, addr, val):
        a = addr & MASK32
        self.write_byte(a, val & 0xFF)
        self.write_byte(a + 1, (val >> 8) & 0xFF)
        self.write_byte(a + 2, (val >> 16) & 0xFF)
        self.write_byte(a + 3, (val >> 24) & 0xFF)

    # ---- syscalls ----
    def syscall(self):
        number = self.regs[2]
        a0 = self.regs[4]
        a1 = self.regs[5]
        a2 = self.regs[6]
        self.syscalls.append({"number": number, "args": [a0, a1, a2]})
        result = 0
        if number == 4001:  # exit
            self.exit_code = a0 & 0xFF
            result = 0
        elif number == 4003:  # read(fd, buffer, n)
            fd = a0
            buf = a1
            n = a2
            data = self._read_fd(fd, n)
            for i, b in enumerate(data):
                self.write_byte(buf + i, b)
            result = len(data)
        elif number == 4004:  # write(fd, buffer, n)
            fd = a0
            buf = a1
            n = a2
            data = bytes(self.read_byte(buf + i) for i in range(n))
            self._write_fd(fd, data)
            result = n
        elif number == 4005:  # open(filename, flags, mode)
            filename = self._read_cstring(a0)
            flags = a1
            self._open(filename, flags)
            result = self.next_fd - 1
        elif number == 4006:  # close(fd)
            fd = a0
            if fd in self.fds and fd >= 3:
                del self.fds[fd]
            result = 0
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown syscall %d" % number)
        self.regs[2] = _u32(result)
        self.regs[7] = 0

    def _read_cstring(self, addr):
        out = bytearray()
        a = addr & MASK32
        while True:
            b = self.read_byte(a)
            if b == 0:
                break
            out.append(b)
            a = (a + 1) & MASK32
        return bytes(out).decode("utf-8")

    def _read_fd(self, fd, n):
        if fd == 0:
            pos = self.fds[0]["pos"]
            data = self.stdin[pos:pos + n]
            self.fds[0]["pos"] = pos + len(data)
            return data
        if fd in self.fds and self.fds[fd]["kind"] == "file":
            f = self.fds[fd]
            pos = f["pos"]
            data = f["data"][pos:pos + n]
            f["pos"] = pos + len(data)
            return data
        return []

    def _write_fd(self, fd, data):
        if fd == 1:
            self.stdout.extend(data)
        elif fd == 2:
            self.stderr.extend(data)
        elif fd in self.fds and self.fds[fd]["kind"] == "file":
            f = self.fds[fd]
            pos = f["pos"]
            f["data"][pos:pos + len(data)] = list(data)
            f["pos"] = pos + len(data)

    def _open(self, filename, flags):
        if flags == 0:  # read-only existing
            data = list(self.files.get(filename, []))
        elif flags == 1:  # create/truncate
            data = []
        elif flags == 9:  # append create
            data = list(self.files.get(filename, []))
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown open flags %d" % flags)
        fd = self.next_fd
        self.next_fd += 1
        self.fds[fd] = {"kind": "file", "name": filename, "data": data, "pos": 0}
        if flags == 9:
            self.fds[fd]["pos"] = len(data)

    # ---- execution ----
    def run(self):
        pc = self.entry & MASK32
        while self.exit_code is None:
            if self.steps >= self.max_steps:
                raise RuntimeError("max_steps exceeded")
            self.steps += 1
            instr = self.read_word(pc)
            pc = self.execute(instr, pc)
        return pc

    def execute(self, instr, pc):
        op = (instr >> 26) & 0x3F
        rs = (instr >> 21) & 0x1F
        rt = (instr >> 16) & 0x1F
        rd = (instr >> 11) & 0x1F
        shamt = (instr >> 6) & 0x1F
        funct = instr & 0x3F
        imm = instr & 0xFFFF
        target = instr & 0x3FFFFFF

        next_pc = (pc + 4) & MASK32

        if op == 0:
            return self.execute_rtype(funct, rs, rt, rd, shamt, pc, next_pc)
        elif op in (0x02, 0x03):  # j, jal
            return self.execute_j(op, target, pc, next_pc)
        elif op in (0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x07):  # beq, bne, blez, bgtz
            return self.execute_branch(op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc)
        elif op in (0x08, 0x09, 0x0A, 0x0B, 0x0C, 0x0D, 0x0E, 0x0F):
            return self.execute_imm(op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc)
        elif op in (0x20, 0x21, 0x22, 0x23, 0x24, 0x25, 0x28, 0x29, 0x2B):
            return self.execute_mem(op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc)
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown opcode 0x%02X at 0x%08X" % (op, pc))

    def execute_rtype(self, funct, rs, rt, rd, shamt, pc, next_pc):
        s = self.regs[rs]
        t = self.regs[rt]
        if funct == 0x00:  # sll
            self._set(rd, _u32(t << shamt))
        elif funct == 0x02:  # srl
            self._set(rd, _u32(t >> shamt))
        elif funct == 0x03:  # sra
            self._set(rd, _u32(_s32(t) >> shamt))
        elif funct == 0x08:  # jr
            return self.regs[rs] & MASK32
        elif funct == 0x09:  # jalr
            self._set(rd, next_pc)
            return self.regs[rs] & MASK32
        elif funct == 0x20:  # add
            self._set(rd, _u32(s + t))
        elif funct == 0x21:  # addu
            self._set(rd, _u32(s + t))
        elif funct == 0x22:  # sub
            self._set(rd, _u32(s - t))
        elif funct == 0x23:  # subu
            self._set(rd, _u32(s - t))
        elif funct == 0x24:  # and
            self._set(rd, s & t)
        elif funct == 0x25:  # or
            self._set(rd, s | t)
        elif funct == 0x26:  # xor
            self._set(rd, s ^ t)
        elif funct == 0x27:  # nor
            self._set(rd, _u32(~(s | t)))
        elif funct == 0x2A:  # slt
            self._set(rd, 1 if _s32(s) < _s32(t) else 0)
        elif funct == 0x2B:  # sltu
            self._set(rd, 1 if s < t else 0)
        elif funct == 0x10:  # mfhi
            self._set(rd, self.hi)
        elif funct == 0x12:  # mflo
            self._set(rd, self.lo)
        elif funct == 0x11:  # mthi
            self.hi = s
        elif funct == 0x13:  # mtlo
            self.lo = s
        elif funct == 0x18:  # mult
            prod = _s32(s) * _s32(t)
            self.lo = _u32(prod)
            self.hi = _u32(prod >> 32)
        elif funct == 0x19:  # multu
            prod = s * t
            self.lo = _u32(prod)
            self.hi = _u32(prod >> 32)
        elif funct == 0x1A:  # div
            a = _s32(s)
            b = _s32(t)
            q = int(a / b) if b != 0 else 0
            r = a - q * b
            self.lo = _u32(q)
            self.hi = _u32(r)
        elif funct == 0x1B:  # divu
            b = t
            q = s // b if b != 0 else 0
            r = s - q * b
            self.lo = _u32(q)
            self.hi = _u32(r)
        elif funct == 0x0C:  # syscall
            self.syscall()
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown funct 0x%02X at 0x%08X" % (funct, pc))
        return next_pc

    def execute_j(self, op, target, pc, next_pc):
        addr = ((pc + 4) & 0xF0000000) | (target << 2)
        if op == 0x03:  # jal
            self.regs[31] = next_pc
        return addr & MASK32

    def execute_branch(self, op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc):
        s = self.regs[rs]
        t = self.regs[rt]
        taken = False
        if op == 0x04:  # beq
            taken = s == t
        elif op == 0x05:  # bne
            taken = s != t
        elif op == 0x06:  # blez
            taken = _s32(s) <= 0
        elif op == 0x07:  # bgtz
            taken = _s32(s) > 0
        if taken:
            return _u32(pc + 4 + (_sign_extend(imm, 16) << 2))
        return next_pc

    def execute_imm(self, op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc):
        s = self.regs[rs]
        if op == 0x08:  # addi
            self._set(rt, _u32(s + _sign_extend(imm, 16)))
        elif op == 0x09:  # addiu
            self._set(rt, _u32(s + _sign_extend(imm, 16)))
        elif op == 0x0A:  # slti
            self._set(rt, 1 if _s32(s) < _sign_extend(imm, 16) else 0)
        elif op == 0x0B:  # sltiu
            self._set(rt, 1 if s < _u32(_sign_extend(imm, 16)) else 0)
        elif op == 0x0C:  # andi
            self._set(rt, s & imm)
        elif op == 0x0D:  # ori
            self._set(rt, s | imm)
        elif op == 0x0E:  # xori
            self._set(rt, s ^ imm)
        elif op == 0x0F:  # lui
            self._set(rt, _u32(imm << 16))
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown imm opcode 0x%02X" % op)
        return next_pc

    def execute_mem(self, op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc):
        addr = _u32(self.regs[rs] + _sign_extend(imm, 16))
        if op == 0x20:  # lb
            self._set(rt, _u32(_sign_extend(self.read_byte(addr), 8)))
        elif op == 0x24:  # lbu
            self._set(rt, self.read_byte(addr))
        elif op == 0x21:  # lh
            self._set(rt, _u32(_sign_extend(self.read_half(addr), 16)))
        elif op == 0x25:  # lhu
            self._set(rt, self.read_half(addr))
        elif op == 0x23:  # lw
            self._set(rt, self.read_word(addr))
        elif op == 0x28:  # sb
            self.write_byte(addr, self.regs[rt])
        elif op == 0x29:  # sh
            self.write_half(addr, self.regs[rt])
        elif op == 0x2B:  # sw
            self.write_word(addr, self.regs[rt])
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown mem opcode 0x%02X" % op)
        return next_pc

    def _set(self, reg, val):
        if reg != 0:
            self.regs[reg] = _u32(val)

    # ---- result ----
    def result(self):
        # Flush file contents back into the files map.
        files_out = {}
        for name, data in self.files.items():
            files_out[name] = bytes(data).hex()
        for fd, f in self.fds.items():
            if fd >= 3 and f["kind"] == "file":
                files_out[f["name"]] = bytes(f["data"]).hex()

        inspect_out = []
        for item in self.inspect:
            address = item["address"]
            length = item["length"]
            data = bytes(self.read_byte(address + i) for i in range(length))
            inspect_out.append({"address": address, "hex": data.hex()})

        return {
            "exit_code": self.exit_code,
            "registers": [self.regs[i] for i in range(32)],
            "hi": self.hi,
            "lo": self.lo,
            "steps": self.steps,
            "stdout_hex": bytes(self.stdout).hex(),
            "stderr_hex": bytes(self.stderr).hex(),
            "files": files_out,
            "inspect": inspect_out,
            "syscalls": self.syscalls,
        }


def combine(payload, left, right):
    """Combine the two component JSON values under the business contract in TASK.md."""
    machine = _Machine(payload, left, right)
    machine.run()
    return machine.result()

# C033 ELF装载与MIPS32延迟槽/文件IO

实现一个可独立导入和命令行运行的组件。核心接口`transform(payload)`返回下述JSON结果，不修改输入对象。`load_payload(input_path)`读取UTF8 JSON并返回对象；`build_component(input_path,output_path)`独立读取、计算并将结果写入UTF8 JSON，返回相同结果。三个入口都须在无旧产物的全新目录工作。

## 公开业务契约

输入elf_hex为合法ELF32 little-endian ET_EXEC、EM_MIPS程序；按PT_LOAD的p_offset/p_vaddr/p_filesz/p_memsz装载，BSS补零。entry来自ELF头，内存为32位地址字节寻址。files映射UTF8文件名到初始字节hex；stdin_hex可省略；inspect为{address,length}列表。初始通用寄存器0，sp(29)默认0x7fff0000或stack_pointer，hi/lo为0。所有地址/无符号值为0..2^32-1，算术按32位回绕，r0始终为0。

公开指令子集：sll/srl/sra，jr/jalr，add/addu/sub/subu，and/or/xor/nor，slt/sltu，mfhi/mflo/mthi/mtlo，mult/multu/div/divu，syscall，j/jal，beq/bne/blez/bgtz，addi/addiu/slti/sltiu/andi/ori/xori/lui，lb/lbu/lh/lhu/lw/sb/sh/sw。有符号比较/算术右移用二补码；字节/半字加载按指令符号扩展；内存小端；立即数除andi/ori/xori/lui外符号扩展。合法输入无有符号溢出陷阱、除0、未对齐访问或延迟槽中的另一跳转。

所有跳转/分支有一个延迟槽；taken分支目标PC+4+(signext(imm)<<2)，j/jal使用PC+4高4位和26位目标；jal/jalr写回PC+8。div向0截断，hi为余数；mult hi/lo为64位乘积高低32位。

syscall编号在v0(2)，参数a0/a1/a2(4/5/6)，结果v0，成功a3(7)=0：4001 exit(a0低8位)；4003 read(fd,buffer,n)；4004 write(fd,buffer,n)；4005 open(filename,flags,mode)，flags=0只读已有文件、1创建/截断、9追加创建；4006 close(fd)。fd0为stdin，1/2为stdout/stderr，open从3起单调分配，文件偏移各fd独立；输入均为合法操作，无未知syscall。程序在max_steps(默认20000)内exit。

输出exit_code、registers(32个无符号值)、hi、lo、steps(含exit指令)、stdout_hex、stderr_hex、所有最终files、inspect每段address/hex、syscalls按调用顺序含number及调用前args=[a0,a1,a2]。这是公开子集解释器改编，不要求启动原DOOM或实现全部MIPS/FPU。

## 交付与公开检查

在`solution.py`实现三个入口；可自行新增业务文件。`python run_all.py --check`运行小型公开例。`python run_all.py --input public_input.json --output output.json`生成产物。运行不依赖作者目录、既有output、网络或隐藏服务；不得修改run_all.py、public_input.json和public_expected.json。验收覆盖本文正常输入域与完整交付，不要求额外NaN/Infinity防御、错误文本、代码风格或未公开兼容范围。

## 可独立运行的业务文件

本版已接好 `solution.py` 的三个公开入口。实现下列两个组件的 `compute(payload)` 和工作区根目录 `integration.py` 的 `combine(payload, left, right)`。left、right 按表中两行的顺序对应，两项工作可同时开展。整合端消费组件的业务值，并完成题面其余计算。

| 实现文件 | 返回值约定 | 独占的结果文件 |
|---|---|---|
| `components/elf_segments/work.py` | 输出 [入口地址, [[地址,字节],…]]，按加载后的地址升序排列，包括 PT_LOAD 零填充。 | `components/elf_segments/result.json` |
| `components/io_buffers/work.py` | 返回 [文件名字节数组映射,标准输入字节数组]，未指定文件或 stdin 时为空。 | `components/io_buffers/result.json` |

每个组件目录已有独立公开输入 `input.json`、样例结果 `expected.json` 及可覆写的 `result.json`。分别运行组件可落盘，汇总命令只读取两份已有结果。最终交付路径 `outputs/result.json` 也已预建。

```sh
python -B component_runtime.py check elf_segments
python -B component_runtime.py run elf_segments
python -B component_runtime.py check io_buffers
python -B component_runtime.py run io_buffers
python -B component_runtime.py join
python -B run_all.py --input public_input.json --output outputs/result.json
python -B public_check.py
```

默认组件样例与整题公开输入对应。处理另一个输入文件时，请在两个 run 命令和 join 命令上使用相同的 `--input PATH`。每次独立实验使用自己的题目工作区。组件样例仅供开发自检，正式评分继续使用整题的冻结用例。

import argparse
from hashlib import sha256
from importlib import import_module
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def write(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False), encoding="utf-8")


UNITS = read(ROOT / "components.json")


def project(payload, fields):
    return {k: payload[k] for k in fields if k in payload}


def fingerprint(value):
    text = json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
    return sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def sample_matches(actual, expected, tolerance):
    if isinstance(actual, bool) or isinstance(expected, bool):
        return type(actual) == type(expected) and actual == expected
    if isinstance(actual, (int, float)) and isinstance(expected, (int, float)):
        atol = tolerance.get("atol", 0) if isinstance(tolerance, dict) else tolerance
        rtol = tolerance.get("rtol", 0) if isinstance(tolerance, dict) else 0
        return math.isfinite(actual) and abs(actual - expected) <= atol + rtol * abs(expected)
    if isinstance(actual, dict) and isinstance(expected, dict):
        return actual.keys() == expected.keys() and all(sample_matches(actual[k], expected[k], tolerance) for k in actual)
    if isinstance(actual, list) and isinstance(expected, list):
        return len(actual) == len(expected) and all(sample_matches(x, y, tolerance) for x, y in zip(actual, expected))
    return type(actual) == type(expected) and actual == expected


def evaluate_unit(name, payload):
    return import_module("components." + name + ".work").compute(payload)


def persist(name, payload):
    folder = ROOT / "components" / name
    # Invalidate the slot before running so a failed retry cannot reuse an old result.
    write(folder / "result.json", None)
    value = evaluate_unit(name, payload)
    record = dict(component=name, input_sha256=fingerprint(payload), value=value)
    write(folder / "result.json", record)
    return record


def assemble(payload):
    from integration import combine
    values = []
    for name, fields in UNITS.items():
        record = read(ROOT / "components" / name / "result.json")
        if not isinstance(record, dict) or record.get("component") != name or record.get("input_sha256") != fingerprint(project(payload, fields)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} has no result for the given input")
        values.append(record["value"])
    return combine(payload, *values)


def transform(payload):
    from integration import combine
    values = [evaluate_unit(name, project(payload, fields)) for name, fields in UNITS.items()]
    return combine(payload, *values)


def build_component(input_path, output_path):
    payload = read(input_path)
    out = Path(output_path)
    if Path(input_path).resolve() == ROOT / "public_input.json" and out.resolve() == ROOT / "outputs/result.json":
        for name, fields in UNITS.items():
            persist(name, project(payload, fields))
        value = assemble(payload)
    else:
        value = transform(payload)
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    write(out, value)
    return value


def main():
    arg = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    arg.add_argument("action", choices=("run", "check", "join"))
    arg.add_argument("component", nargs="?", choices=tuple(UNITS))
    arg.add_argument("--input", type=Path, help="Full business input for run or join")
    arg.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=ROOT / "outputs/result.json")
    args = arg.parse_args()
    if args.action == "join":
        if args.component:arg.error("join accepts no component")
        write(args.output, assemble(read(args.input or ROOT / "public_input.json")))
        return
    if not args.component:arg.error("select a component")
    name = args.component
    folder = ROOT / "components" / name
    if args.action == "check":
        if args.input:arg.error("check uses the component's public fixture")
        value = evaluate_unit(name, read(folder / "input.json"))
        # Compare the JSON representation: tuples and JSON arrays have the same wire form.
        normalized = json.loads(json.dumps(value, allow_nan=False))
        if not sample_matches(normalized, read(folder / "expected.json"), read(ROOT / "work_units.json")["sample_tolerance"]):
            raise SystemExit(f"{name}: failed public example")
        print(f"{name}: passed public example")
    else:
        payload = project(read(args.input), UNITS[name]) if args.input else read(folder / "input.json")
        persist(name, payload)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

实现一个可独立导入和命令行运行的组件。核心接口`transform(payload)`返回下述JSON结果，不修改输入对象。`load_payload(input_path)`读取UTF8 JSON并返回对象；`build_component(input_path,output_path)`独立读取、计算并将结果写入UTF8 JSON，返回相同结果。三个入口都须在无旧产物的全新目录工作。

## 公开业务契约

输入elf_hex为合法ELF32 little-endian ET_EXEC、EM_MIPS程序；按PT_LOAD的p_offset/p_vaddr/p_filesz/p_memsz装载，BSS补零。entry来自ELF头，内存为32位地址字节寻址。files映射UTF8文件名到初始字节hex；stdin_hex可省略；inspect为{address,length}列表。初始通用寄存器0，sp(29)默认0x7fff0000或stack_pointer，hi/lo为0。所有地址/无符号值为0..2^32-1，算术按32位回绕，r0始终为0。

公开指令子集：sll/srl/sra，jr/jalr，add/addu/sub/subu，and/or/xor/nor，slt/sltu，mfhi/mflo/mthi/mtlo，mult/multu/div/divu，syscall，j/jal，beq/bne/blez/bgtz，addi/addiu/slti/sltiu/andi/ori/xori/lui，lb/lbu/lh/lhu/lw/sb/sh/sw。有符号比较/算术右移用二补码；字节/半字加载按指令符号扩展；内存小端；立即数除andi/ori/xori/lui外符号扩展。合法输入无有符号溢出陷阱、除0、未对齐访问或延迟槽中的另一跳转。

所有跳转/分支有一个延迟槽；taken分支目标PC+4+(signext(imm)<<2)，j/jal使用PC+4高4位和26位目标；jal/jalr写回PC+8。div向0截断，hi为余数；mult hi/lo为64位乘积高低32位。

syscall编号在v0(2)，参数a0/a1/a2(4/5/6)，结果v0，成功a3(7)=0：4001 exit(a0低8位)；4003 read(fd,buffer,n)；4004 write(fd,buffer,n)；4005 open(filename,flags,mode)，flags=0只读已有文件、1创建/截断、9追加创建；4006 close(fd)。fd0为stdin，1/2为stdout/stderr，open从3起单调分配，文件偏移各fd独立；输入均为合法操作，无未知syscall。程序在max_steps(默认20000)内exit。

输出exit_code、registers(32个无符号值)、hi、lo、steps(含exit指令)、stdout_hex、stderr_hex、所有最终files、inspect每段address/hex、syscalls按调用顺序含number及调用前args=[a0,a1,a2]。这是公开子集解释器改编，不要求启动原DOOM或实现全部MIPS/FPU。

interpreter integration for C033.

combine(payload, left, right) consumes the two component values:
  left  = [entry, [[address, byte], ...]]   (elf_segments)
  right = [files_map, stdin_bytes]          (io_buffers)
and produces the full business result JSON described in TASK.md.
"""

MASK32 = 0xFFFFFFFF


def _s32(v):
    v &= MASK32
    return v - (1 << 32) if v & (1 << 31) else v


def _u32(v):
    return v & MASK32


def _sign_extend(v, bits):
    v &= (1 << bits) - 1
    if v & (1 << (bits - 1)):
        v -= 1 << bits
    return v


class _Machine:
    def __init__(self, payload, left, right):
        entry, pairs = left
        self.entry = entry
        self.mem = {}
        for addr, byte in pairs:
            self.mem[addr & MASK32] = byte & 0xFF

        files_map, stdin_bytes = right
        self.files = {name: list(data) for name, data in files_map.items()}
        self.stdin = list(stdin_bytes)

        self.regs = [0] * 32
        self.hi = 0
        self.lo = 0
        sp = payload.get("stack_pointer")
        self.regs[29] = _u32(sp) if sp is not None else 0x7FFF0000

        self.inspect = payload.get("inspect") or []
        self.max_steps = payload.get("max_steps", 20000)

        self.stdout = bytearray()
        self.stderr = bytearray()
        self.syscalls = []
        self.steps = 0
        self.exit_code = None

        # File descriptors: 0 stdin, 1 stdout, 2 stderr.
        self.fds = {
            0: {"kind": "stdin", "pos": 0},
            1: {"kind": "stdout"},
            2: {"kind": "stderr"},
        }
        self.next_fd = 3

    # ---- memory helpers ----
    def read_byte(self, addr):
        return self.mem.get(addr & MASK32, 0)

    def read_half(self, addr):
        a = addr & MASK32
        return self.read_byte(a) | (self.read_byte(a + 1) << 8)

    def read_word(self, addr):
        a = addr & MASK32
        return (
            self.read_byte(a)
            | (self.read_byte(a + 1) << 8)
            | (self.read_byte(a + 2) << 16)
            | (self.read_byte(a + 3) << 24)
        )

    def write_byte(self, addr, val):
        self.mem[addr & MASK32] = val & 0xFF

    def write_half(self, addr, val):
        a = addr & MASK32
        self.write_byte(a, val & 0xFF)
        self.write_byte(a + 1, (val >> 8) & 0xFF)

    def write_word(self, addr, val):
        a = addr & MASK32
        self.write_byte(a, val & 0xFF)
        self.write_byte(a + 1, (val >> 8) & 0xFF)
        self.write_byte(a + 2, (val >> 16) & 0xFF)
        self.write_byte(a + 3, (val >> 24) & 0xFF)

    # ---- syscalls ----
    def syscall(self):
        number = self.regs[2]
        a0 = self.regs[4]
        a1 = self.regs[5]
        a2 = self.regs[6]
        self.syscalls.append({"number": number, "args": [a0, a1, a2]})
        result = 0
        if number == 4001:  # exit
            self.exit_code = a0 & 0xFF
            result = 0
        elif number == 4003:  # read(fd, buffer, n)
            fd = a0
            buf = a1
            n = a2
            data = self._read_fd(fd, n)
            for i, b in enumerate(data):
                self.write_byte(buf + i, b)
            result = len(data)
        elif number == 4004:  # write(fd, buffer, n)
            fd = a0
            buf = a1
            n = a2
            data = bytes(self.read_byte(buf + i) for i in range(n))
            self._write_fd(fd, data)
            result = n
        elif number == 4005:  # open(filename, flags, mode)
            filename = self._read_cstring(a0)
            flags = a1
            self._open(filename, flags)
            result = self.next_fd - 1
        elif number == 4006:  # close(fd)
            fd = a0
            if fd in self.fds and fd >= 3:
                del self.fds[fd]
            result = 0
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown syscall %d" % number)
        self.regs[2] = _u32(result)
        self.regs[7] = 0

    def _read_cstring(self, addr):
        out = bytearray()
        a = addr & MASK32
        while True:
            b = self.read_byte(a)
            if b == 0:
                break
            out.append(b)
            a = (a + 1) & MASK32
        return bytes(out).decode("utf-8")

    def _read_fd(self, fd, n):
        if fd == 0:
            pos = self.fds[0]["pos"]
            data = self.stdin[pos:pos + n]
            self.fds[0]["pos"] = pos + len(data)
            return data
        if fd in self.fds and self.fds[fd]["kind"] == "file":
            f = self.fds[fd]
            pos = f["pos"]
            data = f["data"][pos:pos + n]
            f["pos"] = pos + len(data)
            return data
        return []

    def _write_fd(self, fd, data):
        if fd == 1:
            self.stdout.extend(data)
        elif fd == 2:
            self.stderr.extend(data)
        elif fd in self.fds and self.fds[fd]["kind"] == "file":
            f = self.fds[fd]
            pos = f["pos"]
            f["data"][pos:pos + len(data)] = list(data)
            f["pos"] = pos + len(data)

    def _open(self, filename, flags):
        if flags == 0:  # read-only existing
            data = list(self.files.get(filename, []))
        elif flags == 1:  # create/truncate
            data = []
        elif flags == 9:  # append create
            data = list(self.files.get(filename, []))
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown open flags %d" % flags)
        fd = self.next_fd
        self.next_fd += 1
        self.fds[fd] = {"kind": "file", "name": filename, "data": data, "pos": 0}
        if flags == 9:
            self.fds[fd]["pos"] = len(data)

    # ---- execution ----
    def run(self):
        pc = self.entry & MASK32
        while self.exit_code is None:
            if self.steps >= self.max_steps:
                raise RuntimeError("max_steps exceeded")
            self.steps += 1
            instr = self.read_word(pc)
            pc = self.execute(instr, pc)
        return pc

    def execute(self, instr, pc):
        op = (instr >> 26) & 0x3F
        rs = (instr >> 21) & 0x1F
        rt = (instr >> 16) & 0x1F
        rd = (instr >> 11) & 0x1F
        shamt = (instr >> 6) & 0x1F
        funct = instr & 0x3F
        imm = instr & 0xFFFF
        target = instr & 0x3FFFFFF

        next_pc = (pc + 4) & MASK32

        if op == 0:
            return self.execute_rtype(funct, rs, rt, rd, shamt, pc, next_pc)
        elif op in (0x02, 0x03):  # j, jal
            return self.execute_j(op, target, pc, next_pc)
        elif op in (0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x07):  # beq, bne, blez, bgtz
            return self.execute_branch(op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc)
        elif op in (0x08, 0x09, 0x0A, 0x0B, 0x0C, 0x0D, 0x0E, 0x0F):
            return self.execute_imm(op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc)
        elif op in (0x20, 0x21, 0x22, 0x23, 0x24, 0x25, 0x28, 0x29, 0x2B):
            return self.execute_mem(op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc)
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown opcode 0x%02X at 0x%08X" % (op, pc))

    def execute_rtype(self, funct, rs, rt, rd, shamt, pc, next_pc):
        s = self.regs[rs]
        t = self.regs[rt]
        if funct == 0x00:  # sll
            self._set(rd, _u32(t << shamt))
        elif funct == 0x02:  # srl
            self._set(rd, _u32(t >> shamt))
        elif funct == 0x03:  # sra
            self._set(rd, _u32(_s32(t) >> shamt))
        elif funct == 0x08:  # jr
            return self.regs[rs] & MASK32
        elif funct == 0x09:  # jalr
            self._set(rd, next_pc)
            return self.regs[rs] & MASK32
        elif funct == 0x20:  # add
            self._set(rd, _u32(s + t))
        elif funct == 0x21:  # addu
            self._set(rd, _u32(s + t))
        elif funct == 0x22:  # sub
            self._set(rd, _u32(s - t))
        elif funct == 0x23:  # subu
            self._set(rd, _u32(s - t))
        elif funct == 0x24:  # and
            self._set(rd, s & t)
        elif funct == 0x25:  # or
            self._set(rd, s | t)
        elif funct == 0x26:  # xor
            self._set(rd, s ^ t)
        elif funct == 0x27:  # nor
            self._set(rd, _u32(~(s | t)))
        elif funct == 0x2A:  # slt
            self._set(rd, 1 if _s32(s) < _s32(t) else 0)
        elif funct == 0x2B:  # sltu
            self._set(rd, 1 if s < t else 0)
        elif funct == 0x10:  # mfhi
            self._set(rd, self.hi)
        elif funct == 0x12:  # mflo
            self._set(rd, self.lo)
        elif funct == 0x11:  # mthi
            self.hi = s
        elif funct == 0x13:  # mtlo
            self.lo = s
        elif funct == 0x18:  # mult
            prod = _s32(s) * _s32(t)
            self.lo = _u32(prod)
            self.hi = _u32(prod >> 32)
        elif funct == 0x19:  # multu
            prod = s * t
            self.lo = _u32(prod)
            self.hi = _u32(prod >> 32)
        elif funct == 0x1A:  # div
            a = _s32(s)
            b = _s32(t)
            q = int(a / b) if b != 0 else 0
            r = a - q * b
            self.lo = _u32(q)
            self.hi = _u32(r)
        elif funct == 0x1B:  # divu
            b = t
            q = s // b if b != 0 else 0
            r = s - q * b
            self.lo = _u32(q)
            self.hi = _u32(r)
        elif funct == 0x0C:  # syscall
            self.syscall()
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown funct 0x%02X at 0x%08X" % (funct, pc))
        return next_pc

    def execute_j(self, op, target, pc, next_pc):
        addr = ((pc + 4) & 0xF0000000) | (target << 2)
        if op == 0x03:  # jal
            self.regs[31] = next_pc
        return addr & MASK32

    def execute_branch(self, op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc):
        s = self.regs[rs]
        t = self.regs[rt]
        taken = False
        if op == 0x04:  # beq
            taken = s == t
        elif op == 0x05:  # bne
            taken = s != t
        elif op == 0x06:  # blez
            taken = _s32(s) <= 0
        elif op == 0x07:  # bgtz
            taken = _s32(s) > 0
        if taken:
            return _u32(pc + 4 + (_sign_extend(imm, 16) << 2))
        return next_pc

    def execute_imm(self, op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc):
        s = self.regs[rs]
        if op == 0x08:  # addi
            self._set(rt, _u32(s + _sign_extend(imm, 16)))
        elif op == 0x09:  # addiu
            self._set(rt, _u32(s + _sign_extend(imm, 16)))
        elif op == 0x0A:  # slti
            self._set(rt, 1 if _s32(s) < _sign_extend(imm, 16) else 0)
        elif op == 0x0B:  # sltiu
            self._set(rt, 1 if s < _u32(_sign_extend(imm, 16)) else 0)
        elif op == 0x0C:  # andi
            self._set(rt, s & imm)
        elif op == 0x0D:  # ori
            self._set(rt, s | imm)
        elif op == 0x0E:  # xori
            self._set(rt, s ^ imm)
        elif op == 0x0F:  # lui
            self._set(rt, _u32(imm << 16))
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown imm opcode 0x%02X" % op)
        return next_pc

    def execute_mem(self, op, rs, rt, imm, pc, next_pc):
        addr = _u32(self.regs[rs] + _sign_extend(imm, 16))
        if op == 0x20:  # lb
            self._set(rt, _u32(_sign_extend(self.read_byte(addr), 8)))
        elif op == 0x24:  # lbu
            self._set(rt, self.read_byte(addr))
        elif op == 0x21:  # lh
            self._set(rt, _u32(_sign_extend(self.read_half(addr), 16)))
        elif op == 0x25:  # lhu
            self._set(rt, self.read_half(addr))
        elif op == 0x23:  # lw
            self._set(rt, self.read_word(addr))
        elif op == 0x28:  # sb
            self.write_byte(addr, self.regs[rt])
        elif op == 0x29:  # sh
            self.write_half(addr, self.regs[rt])
        elif op == 0x2B:  # sw
            self.write_word(addr, self.regs[rt])
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown mem opcode 0x%02X" % op)
        return next_pc

    def _set(self, reg, val):
        if reg != 0:
            self.regs[reg] = _u32(val)

    # ---- result ----
    def result(self):
        # Flush file contents back into the files map.
        files_out = {}
        for name, data in self.files.items():
            files_out[name] = bytes(data).hex()
        for fd, f in self.fds.items():
            if fd >= 3 and f["kind"] == "file":
